facts.text: Client is E C Dahls Eiendom AS; fire design by ÅF Engineering (AFRY AS).
Described as 7 storeys above ground plus basement, fire class (Brannklasse) 3, fire-project class (tiltaksklasse) 3.

Analysis-based solutions table lists five items, including solid timber in parts of the load-bearing structure ('vurderes som en av flere alternativer'), solid timber in compartment-boundary structures, fire spread between existing and new buildings, pressurised stairwells, and external emergency-service preparedness.
Solid timber is considered for compartment walls between dwelling units on storeys 4 to 7 ('vurderes bygd i massivtre'), and for compartment-boundary structures from storey 5 upward.
The report says use of a combustible load-bearing system for storeys 4 to 7 has not been decided and is not clarified for the project.

Several concept points are clarified only to a very limited extent and must be revised for the framework-permit application (rammetillatelse); the document must also be revised to include full documentation of the noted deviations from pre-accepted performance.
'Ansvarlig søker' (responsible applicant) is recorded as 'Ikke avklart' (not yet determined); AFRY AS (ÅF Engineering AS) is named as responsible for fire design.

Independent control of fire design is required before the application to commence (søknad om igangsettelse) under SAK10; the control must confirm the fire-safety objectives are met and described in the fire concept.

Design-basis documents listed: plans (26.02.2020), sections (29.11.2019) and axonometric (26.09.2019) by ARC Arkitekter Vigsnæs + Kosberg; fire drawings listed as 'Branntegninger (foreløpig)' (preliminary).
Plan-labelled sheets appear in the PDF at pp. 45 and 51 to 60 (text-label scan). Whether they match the drawing list on pp. 2 and 7 was not checked.
